# SplicR engine - Python analysis stack
# Environment: engine/.tools/env  (micromamba, Python 3.11.16, macOS arm64)
# Generated by pinning the verified working state. Every package below was
# imported and functionally exercised; see notes for the three real conflicts.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HARD CONSTRAINT: numpy must stay < 2.0
#   BAGEL2 (engine/.tools/bagel2/BAGEL.py) calls np.in1d, removed in numpy 2.0.
#   Install with:  pip install -c engine/constraints.txt <pkg>
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# tensorflow is pinned to 2.17.1 (not latest 2.21.0) because 2.17.1 is the
#   newest release whose own metadata declares numpy<2.0.0 on Python 3.11.
#   TF >= 2.18 relaxes that to numpy<2.1 / unbounded and is untested here.
#
# pandas is pinned < 3. anndata/scanpy (via ScreenPro2) require pandas<3, and
#   the newer anndata/scanpy that allow pandas 3 require numpy>=2 - forbidden.
#   pandas 2.x is also REQUIRED for drugz: its empirical-Bayes smoothing uses
#   chained assignment (fold_change[col][0:n] = v) which silently no-ops under
#   pandas 3 copy-on-write, giving wrong stdevs with no error.
#
# rs3 0.0.18 was installed with --no-deps. Its pins are unsatisfiable here:
#   scikit-learn<=1.0.2 (no cp311 wheel, source build fails on Cython) and
#   lightgbm<=3.3.5 (no macOS arm64 wheel). It runs against sklearn 1.9 /
#   lightgbm 4.7 via the shim in engine/splicr/rs3_compat.py - import that
#   before any rs3 call. Verified: predict_seq returns correct RS3 z-scores.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
